notes.title: Patch 1.0 - Localization
notes.content:
To streamline this build with that on other platforms, this version only adds the localization options.

Feel free to choose from one of the following:
- English
- Italian
- Spanish
- Romanian
- Greek.

tags.feature: this version only adds the localization options.

notes.title: International Testing and Final Tweaks
notes.content:
Greetings!

We are excited to share the latest update inspired by extensive testing and feedback from our partners. Representatives gathered in Arad, Romania, and a diverse group of young people from Italy, Spain, Romania, and Greece tested the game during a BootCamp in Spain. 

Based on their feedback, we've made significant improvements:
[list]
[*] Enhanced visuals
[*] Improved game help explanations
[*] Updated market-related figures
[*] Fixed a bug related to staff training
[*] Final balancing adjustments
[/list]

Thank you for your invaluable support!

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug related to staff training

notes.title: Final Pre-Release Update
notes.content:
Greetings!

As we gear up for our big launch tomorrow, we're thrilled to announce the final updates and improvements:
[list]
[*] Fine-tuning energy systems, production, and storage.
[*] Enhancing the social aspects of the enterprise.
[*] Overhauling the expenses system.
[*] Updating the game help section.
[*] Conducting comprehensive testing with young participants in a bootcamp.
[*] 
[/list]
Thank you for your support and stay tuned for the release!

Predict Edumedia team
